provenance.capture: Retained checkpoints imported on 2026-10-21; no fresh solver execution.
provenance.paper_duplicate_x: Original digitized rows remain in the legacy table. Exact repeated x coordinates are omitted from display interpolation.

definition.v_fit: Least-squares slope of contour position against physical time over the trailing 5 microsecond window, including its bracketing sample.
definition.fresh_density: Mean density over the outermost 5% of cells on the corresponding side; fresh temperature must remain within 2 K of 298 K.
definition.contour: Linear interpolation of T or OH between adjacent cells; ambiguous or missing contours are rejected.
definition.temperature_marker: Condition-specific retained Cantera anchor; see temperature_anchor_K or marker_level at each point.
definition.value_selection: Final paired valid observation in the frozen history; not a time-averaged steady estimate.
definition.distinction: Density normalization maps the local contour-relative velocity to a fresh-gas basis. During transients it need not equal the steady FreeFlame eigenvalue or the direct v_fit-U_fresh measure.
